messages.text:
The verifier has now reached stats internals.

Rust’s stats collector records median candidates while samples are numeric even if the final inferred column type later degrades to Unicode, so I’m separating “numeric median candidates” from final type-based mean/stddev output.

commands.receipt:
Mismatch argv=['stats', '--median', 'in.csv'] invalid=False
ref status=0 stdout=b'field,type,sum,min,max,min_length,max_length,mean,stddev,median
h1,Unicode,,1,vFTD,1,4,,,
' stderr=b''
got status=0 stdout=b'field,type,sum,min,max,min_length,max_length,mean,stddev,median
h1,Unicode,,1,vFTD,1,4,,,2
' stderr=b''
